verdict.rationale: BigQuery ships built-in AI features such as Gemini conversational analytics, so it is fair to ask whether it can act as an MCP client. However, nothing in the evidence shows it can connect to external MCP servers and use their tools. The only MCP evidence is MCP Toolbox for Databases, an MCP server that exposes BigQuery to other agents. That is the server role and does not count toward this client-side story.
